card: CI is a hand-list that skips the Python lanes: derive lanes, gate coverage
tests_added: scripts/ci-lanes.test.mjs::case 1: the repo's lanes without a python job
deviations_from_card: Revision applied: case 6 denominator is exact - '20 lanes derived, 20 covered, 0 uncovered, 0 stale, 0 unparseable' = 17 web package-script lanes + 3 Python suites; Rust lanes are NOT counted (cargo lines are ignored; the rust job is one fixed fmt/clippy/test job). Coupled file outside write_set: tools/voice/tests/fake_engine.py (adds HOLD<NAME> gate via FAKE_ENGINE_GATES, and a Windows byte-range-locked append for log/span lines) - the pool tests cannot be made deterministic without an event the test controls. Instead of 'assert peak <= 2' the bound test keeps the stronger 'peak == 2', made deterministic by the gate (overlap is forced, a third start is checked for while the gate is closed). Case 1 is permanently tested by cutting the python job out of the live ci.yml (robust to future packages), and was observed literally on today's tree before the build: 'node scripts/ci-lanes.mjs --check' exit 1 naming the three Python lanes. Extra cases beyond the card: 4b (stale python module) and fixture baseline. ci.yml also runs 'node --test scripts/ci-lanes.test.mjs' in the web job. actions/setup-python pinned to v7.0.0 = 5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 (read via gh api, nothing pushed).
notes: Red before: 8 of 8 node cases (planner absent); tests.test_pool 20x loop 17/20 OK at bab51ca (3 fails). After: 20/20, plus 3 concurrent loops x10 = 30/30 under 100% CPU load. A second flake cause was found: when runs are released together, Windows append (seek-then-write) lost span lines; fixed in fake_engine.note. Case 6 hard-codes 20: a package that gains a gate script (e.g. slot B's apps/stage lint) must bump it and add its CI step - that is the design. The python CI job was not run on Linux (no push); tools/voice has one skip locally. Full voice suite: 82 tests OK (skipped=1). Not run: pnpm/cargo gates (no TS or Rust touched).
